spells.name: Battle Shout
spells.desc: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 20 yards by 20.  Lasts 2 min.

spells.name: Battle Stance
spells.desc: A balanced combat stance.

spells.name: Heroic Strike
spells.desc: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Charge
spells.desc: Charge an enemy, generate 9 rage, and stun it for 1 sec.  Cannot be used in combat.

spells.name: Rend
spells.desc: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 15 damage over 9 sec.

spells.name: Thunder Clap
spells.desc: Blasts nearby enemies increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec and doing 10 damage to them.  Will affect up to 4 targets.

spells.name: Hamstring
spells.desc: Maims the enemy, causing 5 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 40% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Bloodrage
spells.desc: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.  The warrior is considered in combat for the duration.

spells.name: Defensive Stance
spells.desc: A defensive combat stance.  Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%.  Increases threat generated.

spells.name: Sunder Armor
spells.desc: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 90 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat.  Can be applied up to 5 times.  Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Taunt
spells.desc: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

spells.name: Overpower
spells.desc: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5.  Only useable after the target dodges.  The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

spells.name: Shield Bash
spells.desc: Bashes the target with your shield for 6 damage.  It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

spells.name: Demoralizing Shout
spells.desc: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 45 for 30 sec.

spells.name: Revenge
spells.desc: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 12 to 14 damage and a high amount of threat.   Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

spells.name: Mocking Blow
spells.desc: A mocking attack that causes 22 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

spells.name: Shield Block
spells.desc: Increases chance to block by 75% for 5 sec, but will only block 1 attack.

spells.name: Disarm
spells.desc: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

spells.name: Cleave
spells.desc: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and his nearest ally.

spells.name: Retaliation
spells.desc: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec.  Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked.  A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

spells.name: Victory Rush
spells.desc: Instantly attack the target causing (1 + Attack Power * 45 / 100) damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.  Only useable within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor.

spells.name: Intimidating Shout
spells.desc: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear.  Up to 5 total nearby enemies will flee in fear.  Lasts 8 sec.

spells.name: Execute
spells.desc: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 125 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 3 additional damage.  Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

spells.name: Challenging Shout
spells.desc: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

spells.name: Shield Wall
spells.desc: Reduces the damage taken from melee attacks, ranged attacks and spells by 75% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Berserker Rage
spells.desc: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage.  Lasts 10 sec.

spells.name: Berserker Stance
spells.desc: An aggressive stance.  Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

spells.name: Intercept
spells.desc: Charge an enemy, causing 25 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

spells.name: Slam
spells.desc: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 32.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.desc: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage to each enemy.

spells.name: Pummel
spells.desc: Pummel the target for 20 damage.  It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

spells.name: Bloodthirst
spells.desc: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your attack power.  In addition, the next 5 successful melee attacks will restore 13 health.  This effect lasts 8 sec.

spells.name: Mortal Strike
spells.desc: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 110 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Devotion Aura
spells.desc: Gives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Holy Light
spells.desc: Heals a friendly target for 42 to 51.

spells.name: Seal of Righteousness
spells.desc: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 3 to 9 Holy damage.  Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 26 Holy damage to an enemy.

spells.name: Blessing of Might
spells.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 20 for 5 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Judgement
spells.desc: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy.  Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

spells.name: Divine Protection
spells.desc: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 6 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself.  Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.

spells.name: Seal of the Crusader
spells.desc: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 36 melee attack power.  The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 20.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

spells.name: Hammer of Justice
spells.desc: Stuns the target for 3 sec.

spells.name: Purify
spells.desc: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

spells.name: Blessing of Protection
spells.desc: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.  Once protected, the target cannot be made invulnerable by Divine Shield, Divine Protection or Blessing of Protection again for 1 min.

spells.name: Lay on Hands
spells.desc: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health.  Drains all of the Paladin's remaining mana when used.

spells.name: Righteous Fury
spells.desc: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 60%.  Lasts 30 min.

spells.name: Redemption
spells.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 65 health and 120 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

spells.name: Blessing of Wisdom
spells.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds for 5 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Retribution Aura
spells.desc: Causes 5 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Blessing of Freedom
spells.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Blessing of Kings
spells.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 5 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Consecration
spells.desc: Consecrates the land beneath Paladin, doing 64 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

spells.name: Exorcism
spells.desc: Causes 90 to 102 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

spells.name: Flash of Light
spells.desc: Heals a friendly target for 67 to 77.

spells.name: Sense Undead
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled.   Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

spells.name: Concentration Aura
spells.desc: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Seal of Justice
spells.desc: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

spells.name: Turn Undead
spells.desc: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 10 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one target can be turned at a time.

spells.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
spells.desc: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Divine Intervention
spells.desc: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way.  Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.

spells.name: Seal of Command
spells.desc: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts 30 sec.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 97 to 105 Holy damage, 194 to 209 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

spells.name: Seal of Light
spells.desc: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 25.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

spells.name: Frost Resistance Aura
spells.desc: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Fire Resistance Aura
spells.desc: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Seal of Wisdom
spells.desc: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 33 mana to the attacker.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

spells.name: Holy Shock
spells.desc: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 204 to 220 Holy damage to an enemy, or 204 to 220 healing to an ally.

spells.name: Summon Warhorse
spells.desc: Summons a warhorse, which serves as a mount.  Speed is increased by 60%.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.desc: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

spells.name: Hammer of Wrath
spells.desc: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 316 to 348 Holy damage.  Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

spells.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
spells.desc: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 45 damage taken per hit to the caster.  Lasts 30 sec.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Holy Wrath
spells.desc: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 368 to 435 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds.

spells.name: Greater Blessing of Might
spells.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 155 for 15 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
spells.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 30 mana every 5 seconds for 15 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
spells.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 15 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

spells.name: Summon Charger
spells.desc: Summons a Charger, which serves as a mount.  Speed is increased by 100%.

spells.name: Auto Shot
spells.desc: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

spells.name: Raptor Strike
spells.desc: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 5.

spells.name: Track Beasts
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Monkey
spells.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Serpent Sting
spells.desc: Stings the target, causing 20 Nature damage over 15 sec.  Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Arcane Shot
spells.desc: An instant shot that causes 13 Arcane damage.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.desc: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 20.  In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible.  The target also appears on the mini-map.  Lasts for 2 min.

spells.name: Concussive Shot
spells.desc: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

spells.name: Aspect of the Hawk
spells.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Beast Training
spells.desc: Lets the Hunter train his pet with various abilities that he has learned.

spells.name: Call Pet
spells.desc: Summons your pet to you.

spells.name: Dismiss Pet
spells.desc: Dismiss your pet.  Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

spells.name: Feed Pet
spells.desc: Feed your pet the selected item.  Feeding your pet increases happiness.  Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

spells.name: Revive Pet
spells.desc: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

spells.name: Tame Beast
spells.desc: Begins taming a beast to be your companion.  Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec.  If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.  Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal.  Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

spells.name: Track Humanoids
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Distracting Shot
spells.desc: Distract the target, causing threat.

spells.name: Mend Pet
spells.desc: Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus.  Lasts 5 sec.

spells.name: Wing Clip
spells.desc: Inflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Eagle Eye
spells.desc: Zooms in the hunter's vision.  Only usable outdoors.  Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Eyes of the Beast
spells.desc: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 1 min.

spells.name: Scare Beast
spells.desc: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one beast can be feared at a time.

spells.name: Immolation Trap
spells.desc: Place a fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 sec.  Trap will exist for 1 min.  Traps can only be placed when out of combat.  Only one trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Mongoose Bite
spells.desc: Counterattack the enemy for 25 damage.  Can only be performed after you dodge.

spells.name: Multi-Shot
spells.desc: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets.

spells.name: Track Undead
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aimed Shot
spells.desc: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 70.

spells.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
spells.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%.  If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Disengage
spells.desc: Attempts to disengage from the target, reducing threat.  Character exits combat mode.

spells.name: Freezing Trap
spells.desc: Place a frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec.  Any damage caused will break the ice.  Trap will exist for 1 min.  Traps can only be placed when out of combat.  Only one trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Growl
spells.desc: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.

spells.name: Scorpid Sting
spells.desc: Stings the target, reducing Strength and Agility by 20 for 20 sec.  Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Beast Lore
spells.desc: Gather information about the target beast.  The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.

spells.name: Track Hidden
spells.desc: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.desc: Increases ranged attack speed by 40%  for 15 sec.

spells.name: Track Elementals
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Frost Trap
spells.desc: Place a frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it.  All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect.  Trap will exist for 1 min.  Traps can only be placed when out of combat.  Only one trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Beast
spells.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Counterattack
spells.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 40 damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.  Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.desc: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you.  Lasts up to 6 min.

spells.name: Flare
spells.desc: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

spells.name: Track Demons
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Explosive Trap
spells.desc: Place a fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 104 to 135 Fire damage and 150 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards.  Trap will exist for 1 min.  Traps can only be placed when out of combat.  Only one trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Viper Sting
spells.desc: Stings the target, draining 616 mana over 8 sec.  Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Aspect of the Pack
spells.desc: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%.  If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Giants
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Volley
spells.desc: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 50 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every second for 6 sec.

spells.name: Aspect of the Wild
spells.desc: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45.  Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Dragonkin
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

macros.name: Pet Attack
macros.about: Sends your pet to attack your target.

macros.name: Pet Follow
macros.about: Calls your pet back to follow you.

macros.name: Pet Passive
macros.about: Stops your pet attacking on its own.

macros.name: Pet Defensive
macros.about: Your pet attacks whatever attacks you.

spells.name: Eviscerate
spells.desc: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power:   1 point  : 6-10 damage   2 points: 11-15 damage   3 points: 16-20 damage   4 points: 21-25 damage   5 points: 26-30 damage

spells.name: Sinister Strike
spells.desc: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Stealth
spells.desc: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%.  Lasts until cancelled.

spells.name: Backstab
spells.desc: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 15 to the target.  Must be behind the target.  Requires a dagger in the main hand.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Pick Pocket
spells.desc: Pick the target's pocket.

spells.name: Gouge
spells.desc: Causes 10 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack.  Target must be facing you.  Any damage caused will revive the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Evasion
spells.desc: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Sap
spells.desc: Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec.  Must be stealthed.  Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat.    Any damage caused will revive the target.  Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

spells.name: Slice and Dice
spells.desc: Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%.  Lasts longer per combo point:   1 point  : 9 seconds   2 points: 12 seconds   3 points: 15 seconds   4 points: 18 seconds   5 points: 21 seconds

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.  Does not break stealth.

spells.name: Kick
spells.desc: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 15 damage.  It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

spells.name: Expose Armor
spells.desc: Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing armor per combo point:   1 point  : 80 armor   2 points: 160 armor   3 points: 240 armor   4 points: 320 armor   5 points: 400 armor

spells.name: Garrote
spells.desc: Garrote the enemy, causing 144 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power.  Must be stealthed and behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Feint
spells.desc: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

spells.name: Pick Lock
spells.desc: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.desc: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target.  Must be stealthed and behind the target.  Requires a dagger in the main hand.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Poisons
spells.desc: You can create and mix poisons, with both found and storebought ingredients.

spells.name: Rupture
spells.desc: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power.  Lasts longer per combo point:   1 point  : 40 damage over 8 secs   2 points: 60 damage over 10 secs   3 points: 84 damage over 12 secs   4 points: 112 damage over 14 secs   5 points: 144 damage over 16 secs

spells.name: Distract
spells.desc: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds.  Does not break stealth.

spells.name: Vanish
spells.desc: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec.  Also breaks movement impairing effects.

spells.name: Cheap Shot
spells.desc: Stuns the target for 4 sec.  Must be stealthed.  Awards 2 combo points.

spells.name: Disarm Trap
spells.desc: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it.  Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

spells.name: Kidney Shot
spells.desc: Finishing move that stuns the target.  Lasts longer per combo point:   1 point  : 1 second   2 points: 2 seconds   3 points: 3 seconds   4 points: 4 seconds   5 points: 5 seconds

spells.name: Lesser Heal
spells.desc: Heal your target for 47 to 58.

spells.name: Power Word: Fortitude
spells.desc: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 3 for 30 min.

spells.name: Shoot
spells.desc: Attack with an equipped wand.

spells.name: Smite
spells.desc: Smite an enemy for 15 to 20 Holy damage.

spells.name: Shadow Word: Pain
spells.desc: A word of darkness that causes 30 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

spells.name: Power Word: Shield
spells.desc: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 48 damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage.  Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

spells.name: Fade
spells.desc: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec.

spells.name: Renew
spells.desc: Heals the target of 45 damage over 15 sec.

spells.name: Desperate Prayer
spells.desc: Instantly heals the caster for 148 to 185.

spells.name: Hex of Weakness
spells.desc: Weakens the target enemy, reducing damage caused by 2 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%.  Lasts 2 min.

spells.name: Mind Blast
spells.desc: Blasts the target for 42 to 46 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 70 health and 135 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

spells.name: Starshards
spells.desc: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 84 Arcane damage over 6 sec.

spells.name: Touch of Weakness
spells.desc: The next melee attack against the caster will cause 8 Shadow damage and reduce the damage caused by the attacker by 2 for 2 min.

spells.name: Inner Fire
spells.desc: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 315.  Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge.  Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

spells.name: Cure Disease
spells.desc: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

spells.name: Psychic Scream
spells.desc: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 2 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spells.name: Heal
spells.desc: Heal your target for 307 to 353.

spells.name: Dispel Magic

spells.desc: Creates a Spellstone for the caster.  When equipped and used, the Spellstone removes all magic effects from the caster and will absorb 400 magic damage for 1 min.  In addition, equipping the Spellstone improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 1%.Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Detect Invisibility
spells.desc: Allows the friendly target to detect invisibility for 10 min.

spells.name: Dark Pact
spells.desc: Drains 150 of your pet's Mana, returning 100% to you.

spells.name: Howl of Terror
spells.desc: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 10 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spells.name: Soul Link
spells.desc: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter demon instead.  In addition, both the demon and master will inflict 3% more damage.  Lasts as long as the demon is active.

spells.name: Summon Felsteed
spells.desc: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.  Speed is increased by 60%.

spells.name: Death Coil
spells.desc: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 301 Shadow damage.  The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

spells.name: Soul Fire
spells.desc: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 640 to 801 Fire damage.

spells.name: Detect Greater Invisibility
spells.desc: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.desc: Burn your enemy for ? to ? damage and increase all Fire damage you deal by 40% for the next 15 sec.

spells.name: Inferno
spells.desc: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec.  An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min.  Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control.  Can only be used outdoors.

spells.name: Curse of Doom
spells.desc: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 3200 Shadow damage after 1 min.  If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned.  Cannot be cast on players.

spells.name: Ritual of Doom
spells.desc: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard.  The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants.  Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual.  In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

spells.name: Summon Dreadsteed
spells.desc: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.  Speed is increased by 100%.

macros.name: Pet Attack
macros.about: Sends your pet to attack your target.

macros.name: Pet Follow
macros.about: Calls your pet back to follow you.

macros.name: Pet Passive
macros.about: Stops your pet attacking on its own.

macros.name: Pet Defensive
macros.about: Your pet attacks whatever attacks you.

macros.name: Torment
macros.about: Voidwalker taunt: the target attacks your Voidwalker.

macros.name: Sacrifice
macros.about: Sacrifices your Voidwalker to put a shield on you.

macros.name: Pet ability
macros.desc:
#showtooltip
/cast [pet:Voidwalker] Suffering; [pet:Imp] Phase Shift; [pet:Succubus] Lash of Pain; [pet:Felhunter] Devour Magic
macros.about: Casts your demon's main ability: Suffering, Phase Shift, Lash of Pain or Devour Magic.

macros.name: Seduce / Spell Lock
macros.about: Your Succubus seduces the target, or your Felhunter interrupts it with Spell Lock.

macros.name: Corruption + pet
macros.about: Sends your pet in and casts Corruption.

macros.name: Use Healthstone
macros.desc:

/use Major Healthstone
/use Greater Healthstone
/use Healthstone
/use Lesser Healthstone
/use Minor Healthstone

macros.desc:

/use [@player] Major Soulstone
/use [@player] Greater Soulstone
/use [@player] Soulstone
/use [@player] Lesser Soulstone

spells.name: Healing Touch
spells.desc: Heals a friendly target for 40 to 55.

spells.name: Mark of the Wild
spells.desc: Increases the friendly target's armor by 25 for 30 min.

spells.name: Wrath
spells.desc: Causes 13 to 16 Nature damage to the target.

spells.name: Moonfire
spells.desc: Burns the enemy for 9 to 12 Arcane damage and then an additional 12 Arcane damage over 9 sec.

spells.name: Rejuvenation
spells.desc: Heals the target for 32 over 12 sec.

spells.name: Thorns
spells.desc: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 3 Nature damage to attackers when hit.  Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Entangling Roots
spells.desc: Roots the target in place and causes 20 Nature damage over 12 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only useable outdoors.

spells.name: Bear Form
spells.desc: Shapeshift into a bear, increasing melee attack power by 120, armor contribution from items by 180%, and health by 560.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Demoralizing Roar
spells.desc: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 40.  Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.desc: While active, any time an enemy strikes the caster they have a 35% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots (Rank 1).  Only useable outdoors.  1 charge.  Lasts 45 sec.

spells.name: Teleport: Moonglade
spells.desc: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

spells.name: Enrage
spells.desc: Generates 20 rage over 10 sec, but  reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form.  The druid is considered in combat  for the duration.

spells.name: Regrowth
spells.desc: Heals a friendly target for 93 to 107 and another 98 over 21 sec.

spells.name: Revive
spells.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 15% of their health and mana.  Cannot be used when in combat.

spells.name: Bash
spells.desc: Stuns the target for 2 sec.

spells.name: Cure Poison
spells.desc: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

spells.name: Aquatic Form
spells.desc: Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Swipe
spells.desc: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 18 damage.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.desc: Decrease the armor of the target by 175 for 40 sec.  While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

spells.name: Hibernate
spells.desc: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 20 sec.  Any damage will awaken the target.  Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time.  Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

spells.name: Maul
spells.desc: Increases the druid's next attack by 27 damage.

spells.name: Cat Form
spells.desc: Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 40 plus Agility.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Rebirth
spells.desc: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 400 health and 700 mana.

spells.name: Shred
spells.desc: Shred the target, causing 225% damage plus 54 to the target.  Must be behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Starfire
spells.desc: Causes 95 to 115 Arcane damage to the target.

spells.name: Soothe Animal
spells.desc: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards.  Only affects Beast targets level 40 or lower.  Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Rake
spells.desc: Rake the target for 19 damage and an additional 39 damage over 9 sec.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.desc: Dispels 1 Curse from a friendly target.

spells.name: Abolish Poison
spells.desc: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

spells.name: Dash
spells.desc: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.  Does not break prowling.

spells.name: Challenging Roar
spells.desc: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

spells.name: Claw
spells.desc: Claw the enemy, causing 39 additional damage.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Cower
spells.desc: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

spells.name: Rip
spells.desc: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:   1 point  : ? damage over 12 sec.   2 points: ? damage over 12 sec.   3 points: ? damage over 12 sec.   4 points: ? damage over 12 sec.   5 points: ? damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Insect Swarm
spells.desc: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 2% and causing 138 Nature damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Tranquility
spells.desc: Regenerates all nearby group members for 98 every 2 seconds for 10 sec.  Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

spells.name: Travel Form
spells.desc: Transforms the druid into a travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.  Only useable outdoors.The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Ferocious Bite
spells.desc: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 1 additional damage.  Damage is increased by your Attack Power.   1 point  : 50-66 damage   2 points: 86-102 damage   3 points: 122-138 damage   4 points: 158-174 damage   5 points: 194-210 damage

spells.name: Ravage
spells.desc: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 147 to the target.  Must be prowling and behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Track Humanoids
spells.desc: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.  Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

spells.name: Frenzied Regeneration
spells.desc: Converts up to 10 rage per second into health for 10 sec.  Each point of rage is converted into 10 health.

spells.name: Pounce
spells.desc: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 90 damage over 18 sec.  Must be prowling and behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Dire Bear Form
spells.desc: Shapeshift into a dire bear, increasing melee attack power by 180, armor contribution from items by 360%, and health by 1240.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

spells.name: Hurricane
spells.desc: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 72 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks of enemies by 25%.  Lasts 10 sec.  Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

spells.name: Innervate
spells.desc: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting.  Lasts 20 sec.

spells.name: Prowl
spells.desc: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 35%.  Lasts until cancelled.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.desc: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for ? damage over 15 sec plus 20% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.desc: The druid's skin becomes as tough as bark.  Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%.  While protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays but non-instant spells take 1 sec longer to cast and melee combat is slowed by 25%.  Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Mangle
spells.desc: Mangle the target for 160% normal damage and cause the target to take 30% additional damage from Bleed effects and Shred for 1 min. This ability benefits from and triggers all effects associated with Claw and Maul.Hitting a target with Mangle (Bear) also grants you 4 Attack Power for each point of your defense skill beyond (60 * 5). Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.desc: Heals all of target player's party members within 43.5 yards of target player for ? over 7 sec. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

shared.name: Hearthstone
shared.desc: Returns you to your home inn.

shared.name: Assist focus
shared.about: Targets whatever your focus target is targeting.
